modules.description: Transcoding DMR, D-Star, M17, and YSF. Chaverim TAC1.

reflectors.description:
Multiprotocol reflector sponsored by the Chaverim Radio Club. Currently supported modes are:

 

  • - Module A: D-STAR, DMR, M17, and C4FM/YSF
  • - Module B: Future Use
  • - Module C: Future Use
  • - Module D: Future Use
  • - Module E: Echo

 

Module A linked to Brandmeister TG 3213520

 

WEEKLY NETS

 

Please join us for our weekly multiprotocol nets on XLX218 Module A:

- Washington DC Area Net every Thursday at 9PM US Eastern Time (Friday 0200 UTC).

- Worldwide Net every Sunday at 2000 UTC

 

73 & 18!

reflectors.name: Indiana State Wide All Mode Reflector
reflectors.description:
This is the state wide multi-mode reflector for Indiana. All modes are active but the reflector is still being tested so may be down from time to time.

 

The multi-mode reflector will allow users of one mode to talk with users of that and all other modes at the same time. Uses will include general rag-chewing, state level coordination, and Emergency Management support activities.
